emily.release: FYI: short emergency change to this week's release freeze due to upstream storage maintenance + updated canary rollback thresholds. Please read and ack.

devin: what changed exactly?

emily.release: Freeze start moved earlier by 3 hours (now Tue 19:00 UTC) and extended by 2 hours at the end (now Sat 08:00 UTC) for this cycle only. Also publishing precise rollback thresholds so automation can act deterministically.

ops-oncall: New rollback thresholds posted to Grafana and alerts:
- Canary error rate >= 2.5% for 10m -> rollback.
- Host CPU > 85% for 5m during canary -> rollback.
- Prod ramp P95 > 1.3x baseline for 15m -> abort.
- Eval quality: >1.5% critical failures on golden set -> halt rollout.

hana: will rollback automatically kick off a deploy?

emily.release: Yes if alert is fired. Automation runs the rollback playbook and captures a debug snapshot (5m KV cache + light trace) to s3://redwood-rollbacks/<release-id>/. Ops will notify release channel.

devin: exceptions? we might need a last-minute hotfix.

emily.release: Emergency exceptions require eng manager + oncall sign-off. Use /policy-exception with release-id. Hotpatches outside the window are discouraged.

release-bot: Calendar updated: https://go/release-calendar/212000 (auto-notify).

emily.release: Action items: 1) Stop merges to main from Tue 19:00 -> Sat 08:00 unless approved. 2) Release leads: add canary offsets to the spreadsheet by EOD. 3) Ops: validate alert routing and S3 perms. A quick ack here when done please.

ops-oncall: validated grafana alerts and S3 write perms. ack.
